body.name: Kim--Lee empirical-certificate handle
body.construction: For each preregistered observable stratum of \(\mathscr D_{\mathrm{KL}}\), use the fixed \(K=3\) chart and frame and compute \(\widehat R_{\mathrm{HDK}}=\|(I_3-\widehat\Pi_F)\widehat{\bar h}\|_2\). One panel-level Gaussian multiplier bootstrap jointly perturbs \(\widehat m\), recomputes every diagnostic and \(\widehat\theta\), and returns the common \(1-\alpha_{\mathrm{cert}}\) maximum-statistic critical value \(\widehat q_{\mathrm{cert}}\) and endpoints \(\operatorname{LCB}_N,\operatorname{UCB}_N\). Declare \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{KL}}\) to occur only if, for at least one stratum, \(\operatorname{LCB}_N(\sigma_3(\widehat H))\ge\kappa_H\), \(\operatorname{LCB}_N(\sigma_3(\widehat{\bar K}_0))\ge\kappa_0\), \(\operatorname{LCB}_N(\sigma_d(\widehat V_F))\ge\kappa_F\), \(\operatorname{LCB}_N(\min_{(g,r)\in\mathcal G}\widehat p_g)\ge\kappa_p\), \(\operatorname{LCB}_N(\min_j\widehat\Sigma_{jj})\ge\kappa_V\), and \(\operatorname{UCB}_N(\widehat R_{\mathrm{HDK}})\le\varepsilon_{\mathrm{HDK}}\); the simultaneous interval for \(\sigma_{d+1}(\widehat V_D)\) is disjoint from \((0,\kappa_{\mathrm{gap}})\) when \(d<3\); and \(\widehat\omega_{\max}\le\omega_{\max}\). All constants, strata, chart, frame, grid, and the convention that no omitted singular value is tested when \(d=3\) are fixed before inspecting outcomes.
